lines: Yawns arise in the passing days
Through the clamorous night, today as well
Let my true voice resonate, look
Even if I pretend not to see
Alas, I draw as I feel
In the color I chose myself
I say I love what I love
I'm terrified, unable to help it
Alas, the farther I reach, the farther it goes
Even today that doesn't go as I wish
The resentful feeling is merely pitiful
The deeper I step in, the more it hurts
Alas, I move as I feel
On the road I chose myself
On nights when heavy lids are rubbed
Alas, as many as you like, look, as many as you like
Because I lack confidence I have been drawing
Alas, as many times as you like, look, as many times as you like
What I've piled up becomes my weapon
Even if I look around, even if I compare to anyone
Even now I have no confidence, yet
All this pain I felt for the first time
I touched a still small light
It's okay, let's go, only enjoyment remains
In a color only I can produce
Now I'm no longer the transparent me of that day
Let my true voice resonate, look
Even if I pretend not to see
It is certainly there now, still there
Let my true voice resonate, now
Even if I pretend not to see
It is certainly there, within you
